title_zh: 更正紫外线展台告示并保留防护屏障

scenario.label_zh: 修订紫外线展台的操作与防护说明
scenario.goal_zh: 依据展台安全说明删去观众可打开屏障的指示，改为由工作人员演示并保持防护

context_zh: 学生布置由工作人员操作的科学展台，并核对现成的安全说明。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Rose
sentences.text: My sign says visitors can open this cover to see the lamp more clearly.

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.text: That conflicts with the exhibit instructions. The cover provides protection from the radiation produced by the lamp.

sentences.speaker: Rose
sentences.text: Even when it doesn't look very bright?

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.text: Yes. The instructions describe direct exposure as potentially harmful. We shouldn't judge safety by brightness.

sentences.speaker: Rose
sentences.text: I'll replace the sign with 'Please ask a member of staff for a demonstration'.

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.text: Good. Keep the cover closed, and ask the supervisor to check the new sign before we open.
